findings.highlight: Hence, magi only try to hide themselves to escape the Association.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師が自身を隠そうとするのは、[ruby text=ひとえ]偏に協会の粛清から逃れる為なのだとか。
findings.governingReading: Magi are said to conceal themselves solely to escape purging by the Association.
findings.explanation: Escape the Association omits 粛清, removing the violent enforcement mechanism that explains secrecy.

findings.highlight: make the usual broth egg and broth boil
findings.evidenceJa: 定番のだし巻たまごをやっつけて、余り物のこんにゃくをおかか煮にして
findings.governingReading: Shirou makes his standard rolled dashi omelet and simmers leftover konnyaku with bonito flakes.
findings.explanation: Broth egg and broth boil erase both recognizable preparations and their ingredient distinction, turning domestic competence into malformed generic food.
